items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Kolax had a dance band before he had a nightclub.

ctx.x: King Kolax. Was that a dance band?
Yeah. Kolax had a dance band before he had a nightclub. Red Saunders.
Red Saunders and the DeLisa. Did you learn a great deal —
